description.value: Mario's Kitchen is a family-owned Italian restaurant in Tsawwassen operated by Liz and Darren Gates, serving fresh food, wine, and craft beers in a fun, welcoming neighbourhood atmosphere. The restaurant also operates an adjacent venue, Gracie's Next Door, which hosts live music on weekends and offers cocktails and craft beer in a relaxed setting. The kitchen runs brunch through dinner service with rotating weekly specials and online ordering with local delivery.
